method: Items are published only when an official primary source or at least two independent publishers support them.

items.headline: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro advance to presidential runoff on 25 October
items.summary: In the first round on 4 October, Flávio Bolsonaro of the PL received 47.03 percent of valid votes and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva of the PT 45.16 percent, according to figures from the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) with almost all ballots counted. The two will contest the second round on 25 October, reported Agência Brasil.
items.note: Absolute vote counts differ slightly between the TSE page and Agência Brasil, so only percentages are quoted. The runoff date is stated by Agência Brasil, not on the TSE page opened.
